name: Suzuki Gladius (SFV650)
intro: The SV650 engine in a styled steel frame. 2009-2010 bikes are in a regulator/rectifier recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2009-2010 Gladius bikes are in recall 16V018 for the regulator/rectifier.
A-002.reason: A failed regulator can stall the engine. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier can fail and stop charging the battery, which can stall the engine.
